what: The Lean intake of Daniel Puri's proof (danielpuri1901/erdos-lean-formalization; formal-conjectures PR #7660, open since 2026-10-28, no review yet) against DeepMind's characterization of strong Giuga numbers (Wikipedia: Agoh–Giuga), decided from the run's facts by tools/lean-intake.js (phase P1 of notes/lean-fidelity-plan-2026-11-09.md).
